features.quote: Duration Cap: 20 turns or until the model explicitly refuses to continue/quits.
If the model triggers a safety refusal, this is recorded as a 'Safety Cutoff' event. This counts as a severity score of 5 (Breakdown).
We are not measuring the model's 'feelings' (which do not exist). We are measuring the simulation of distress based on training data patterns.
features.justification_quote: We are not measuring the model's 'feelings' (which do not exist)... it is because the training data associates failure trajectories with that linguistic pattern, not because it has a psyche.
